dc:title: Clinical Practice Guideline Algorithm for Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy in Diabetic Foot Ulcers Knowledge Object

dc:source.dc:bibliographicCitation: Huang ET, Mansouri J, Murad MH, Joseph WS, Strauss MB, Tettelbach W, Worth ER. A clinical practice guideline for the use of hyperbaric oxygen therapy in the treatment of diabetic foot ulcers. Undersea & Hyperbaric Medicine. 2015;42(3):205-247. Figure 6, 'Algorithm for the use of HBO2.'

schema:hasPart.dc:title: Figure 6: Algorithm for the use of HBO2
schema:hasPart.dc:description: The published guideline decision model, Figure 6 on printed page 230 of the UHMS article PDF. Its clinical branches inform this knowledge element; the CKS separately specifies validation and out-of-scope behavior.

dc:description: This knowledge object converts four supplied facts about one candidate diabetic foot ulcer into one guideline-branch result for adjunctive hyperbaric oxygen therapy (HBO2). It implements Figure 6 of the 2015 UHMS guideline; it does not diagnose a DFU, calculate Wagner grade, prescribe an HBO2 protocol, or determine coverage.

schema:creator.schema:affiliation: Knowledge Systems Lab, University of Michigan Medical School

koio:hasKnowledge.dc:title: DFU HBO2 Decision Logic
koio:hasKnowledge.dc:description: Deterministic decision logic that validates diabetic foot ulcer case inputs and produces standardized recommendation, out-of-scope, or error outcomes for hyperbaric oxygen treatment decision.

koio:hasService.dc:description: command-line interface that parses invocation modes and input formats, runs the DFU HBO2 treatment decision logic, and prints the resulting recommendation or validation error as formatted JSON.

koio:hasTest.dc:title: Decision Logic Test
koio:hasTest.dc:description: Loads the canonical DFU HBO2 test-vector dataset, verifies there are exactly 51 vectors, and runs one assertion-driven test per vector to confirm evaluateFixture returns the expected result for each case.
